pairs.reason: A's first screen holds the headline, install command and full code, with curly quotes and clean diagrams. C is more distinctive but has a straight apostrophe, broken inline code and a truncated label.
A has its own character (warm paper, contour motif, forest green) and larger, well-set code. B reads as a generic slate-and-blue SaaS page with tiny long-line code.
C's expanded display type and its yellow/pink/blue device colours make the page memorable and explain the merge. B could be any blue SaaS template.

notes: None of the three invents social proof. A is the most complete and precise. C has the strongest identity and type voice but more small craft slips. B has the best merge diagram but the least character. Frame edges on A cross its sticky header; this comes from the renderer and does not count against A.
